listing.name: Wishgranters Faction
listing.summary: Adds a new faction with ships based on Norse mythology and weather effects.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with ships based on Norse mythology and weather effects.

description:
Hey all, I messaged Trylobot to check if this was complete enough for posting, but what the hell: I'm impatient.

So I started creating this mod about two days ago, and it seems ready for a first look. I present to you, the Wishgranters faction.

From left to right we have:

17m - Alvitr Drone - Wing of 6 -Shield/Fighter harass. Cheap, and manpower free.

51m - Aegir Heavy Fighter - Wing of 3 -Fighter hunters.

51m - Forseti Bomber - Wing of 3 -EMP bombers.

51m - Eir Gunship - Wing of 2 - Anti-Fighter protection, with an absolute TORRENT of gunfire. God I love these guys.

94m - Rota Class Corvette - Wing of 2 -Two-in-one Frigate, basically, with the bonus of being repairable at a carrier (albeit slowly).

136m - Tyr Class Frigate - Gun focused frigate.

134m - Ullr Class Frigate - Missile boat frigate. Two SRMs, two MRMs.

162m - Fenris Class Superheavy Frigate - Burn drive, forward facing heavy assault weapons.

328m - Freya Class Carrier Cruiser - Carrier + undecided weapon loadout. This is the newest ship and only has a sprite so far.

All of these except the Freya Carrier are functioning in game with a couple custom weapons (literally two), sorta balanced "first draft" stats, and defined roles in the Wishgranter fleets.

The design philosophy behind the Wishgranters is thus:

- Small, ineffective omni shields.

- Heavier armour to balance the above.

- Low-ish hull hitpoints.

- Strong support wings: especially the Aegir, Forseti and Eir.

- Massive outpouring of fire. Rapid fire, long range, good accuracy: pick two. Then throw in low per-shot damage.

- Heavily standardised weapons and ship components: Corporate greed leads to homogenisation, fortunately the weapons and ships produced are effective

despite

cost cutting measures.

Technical design:

- Strong theming across ship design, naming, variants and background technology. Note the standard turret slots, standard cockpit/command deck, and flux dissipation vanes on the rear.

- All ship classes are named after figures from Norse mythology. All variants are named after pleasant and enjoyable weather effects. Ship names will be generated from the BEAST list.

- Ships created using BSF Ship Maker, using sprites drawn by Kaelis. All credit to him for his excellent work, without which my ships would look like crap.

- A standard five-colour mono complementary palette used across all elements, including weapons, engine trails, tracer fire, impact explosions.

- A single detailing colour (that beautiful blood red) used to contrast and provide asymmetry.

All of that with a racial back story to match and explain. I'll post that later when it's more suitable for viewing.

Anyway, take a look, tell me what you think, post any ideas and questions you may have.

Here's a link to the mod so far for anyone who wants to take a closer look:

http://www.mediafire.com/?sza329jo9waarq5

Make sure you make a backup of your player.faction file and throw the .zipped one in its place. Then start up a new game and jump into a fleet battle with the ready made fleet, check out things in motion.

Disclaimer: it's not balanced yet.

Tools used:

- BSF Ship Maker with Kaelis' sprites.

- Paint.NET

- thanks to Trylobot

- Notepad++

- Time probably better spent exercising, having a life etc.
